answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 769 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to accept the money from the insurance company due to an accident? Question: Is it permissible to accept the money from the insurance company due to an accident? Answer ID: 769 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 377/362=N) It is prohibited to accept more than the amount you deposited, because the additional amount is interest which has been explicitly declared haram in Islam. The Quran says: واحل اللہ البیع و حرم الربوا (الآیۃ) ?Allah hath Permitted trade and forbidden usury? (2/275) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
